_comment: WHAT EXISTS where a generated room has a drop (content sets GEN-5): one terrain kind, a ledge you can jump down onto moving south and cannot climb from any other side. Its pass is one-way with fixed dirs [S] (the engine's entry_gates: every other way in is shut). It says generate: true, so a world that names this pack under "what exists" (params.exists) lets the "Randomly placed tiles" maze biome place it, only where the room's logic stays exactly as it was (GEN-4's laws (a)-(d)). Never offered by a theme (⚖ Q4). The direction is the kind's, not the placement's: per-placement dirs would need a pack field (a later design question).

gen5.note: the ledges pack, content sets GEN-5 (Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5). No approval of its names or shapes is recorded
